en_title: Neuralink Participant Showcases What It's Like to Play GTA 6 With His Mind
cn_title: Neuralink参与者展示用意念玩《GTA 6》的体验
opus_summary: Neuralink分享了一段视频，展示一名临床试验参与者如何利用脑植入技术，在《GTA6》中驾驶船只、操纵飞机和参与枪战。该参与者表示，他此前使用口控棒和iPad玩游戏，容易感到酸痛。Neuralink称，其设备仍处于研究阶段，尚未获监管机构批准。

paragraphs.en: A Neuralink participant has shared a video showcasing how the technology has allowed him to drive boats, fly planes, and get in shootouts in GTA 6 with his mind.
paragraphs.cn: 一名Neuralink参与者分享了一段视频，展示这项技术如何让他在《GTA 6》中用意念驾驶船只和飞机，并参与枪战。

paragraphs.en: Neuralink shared a video of one of its few participants playing Rockstar Games' latest on social media yesterday. The two-minute highlight reel showed how the individual can use the brain implant tech to take Jason through Leonida with ease, saying that previous methods would often leave him sore.
paragraphs.cn: Neuralink昨天在社交媒体上分享了一段视频，展示其为数不多的一名参与者游玩Rockstar最新作品的过程。这段两分钟的精彩片段展示了这名参与者如何利用大脑植入技术轻松操控Jason在Leonida闯荡；他表示，此前使用的方法经常会让他感到疼痛。

paragraphs.en: Playing GTA VI with a Neuralink https://t.co/ViFjXK9OSV

"Before the old chip and surgery, I was using a mouth stick and an iPad," he explained. "I was essentially like a bird, just pecking at an iPad. There was a few games I could play, but obviously, it made your jaw sore and everything sore.
paragraphs.cn: 他解释说：「在植入旧芯片和接受手术之前，我用的是口衔棒和iPad。我基本上就像只鸟，只是在iPad上啄来啄去。我能玩几款游戏，但显然，那会让你的下巴疼，全身都疼。

paragraphs.en: "So then, I get a chip, and it's like, 'What does this let me do?' Immediately, controlling a computer is like, 'boom.' Portal to the world. You just immediately get your portal to the world back."
paragraphs.cn: 「后来我植入了一枚芯片，心想：『这能让我做什么？』控制电脑立刻就变得像是『砰』的一下，通往世界的门户。你立刻就重新拥有了通往世界的门户。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar spent 13 years painstakingly crafting the world of GTA 6 to ensure every blade of grass and every line of dialogue was given an unprecedented amount of detail. Although it's maybe truer to life than some may have hoped, there's no denying that the amount of freedom the studio gives players to do everything from robbing banks to diving for sunken treasure has attracted tens of millions of players .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar花费13年精心打造《GTA 6》的世界，确保每一片草叶和每一句对白都拥有前所未有的丰富细节。尽管它或许比某些人希望的更加贴近现实，但不可否认的是，工作室给予玩家的自由度——从抢劫银行到潜水寻找沉宝，无所不包——吸引了数千万玩家。

paragraphs.en: Despite guiding Jason and Lucia through GTA 6 by different means, the Neuralink participant shown today is one of those millions. In a follow-up post, the tech company, which was co-founded by controversial figure and billionaire Elon Musk, reiterated that the participant and others like him are part of an extremely limited clinical trial.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管操控Jason和Lucia在《GTA 6》中闯荡的方式不同，今天展示的这名Neuralink参与者也是这数千万玩家之一。这家由备受争议的人物、亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克共同创立的科技公司在后续帖子中重申，这名参与者和其他与他情况相似的人参与的是一项规模极其有限的临床试验。

paragraphs.en: "Neuralink devices are investigational and have not been approved by the FDA or other regulatory authorities," it said. "This content features voluntary clinical trial participants sharing their personal experiences, which may not reflect all participants or future outcomes."
paragraphs.cn: 该公司表示：「Neuralink设备仍处于研究阶段，尚未获得FDA或其他监管机构的批准。本内容中自愿参与临床试验的人士分享了他们的个人体验，这些体验可能无法反映所有参与者的情况或未来的结果。」

paragraphs.en: The first human patient to enter the Neuralink program used it to stay up all night playing Civilization 6 in 2024. A few months later, he was playing Slay the Spire .
paragraphs.cn: 2024年，首位参与Neuralink项目的人类患者用它通宵玩《文明6》。几个月后，他玩起了《杀戮尖塔》。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave GTA 6, the highest-rated video game of all time , a 10/10 review . For more, you can read about how Rockstar did its best to make every last NPC feel alive . You can also read about why some of these same NPCs have gone viral for being especially memorable .
paragraphs.cn: IGN给有史以来评分最高的电子游戏《GTA 6》打出了10/10分。想了解更多，你可以阅读Rockstar如何竭尽全力让每一个NPC都显得鲜活。你还可以了解其中一些NPC为何因格外令人难忘而走红。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？不妨就在IGN查看《GTA 6》官方攻略。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过第一章攻略与提示及第二章攻略与提示了解前几章的全部细节。如果你已经开车在Leonida四处游历，想知道所有可以发现和可以做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
